rca of the issue: Original bug: /api/admin/shifts/ai-suggest-week ignored site opening hours, so Claude could return shifts on closed days or outside operating windows. Fix: (1) helpers _hhmm_to_min, _location_opening_hours, _clamp_shift_to_hours, _WEEKDAY_KEYS added; (2) endpoint now fetches opening_hours, returns HTTP 400 when empty, injects SITE_OPENING_HOURS into the Claude prompt, and post-processes every returned shift via _clamp_shift_to_hours (drop closed days, trim to open-30/close+30 buffer, drop sub-30-min results); (3) reasoning string gets an 'Adjustments:' suffix when overrides happened. Verified by direct unit tests on _clamp_shift_to_hours (closed-day → None, 06:00 with 09:00 open → 08:30, 22:00 with 17:00 close → 17:30, sub-30-min result → None, close<=open → None) and an API call confirming 400 (not 500) when opening_hours is forced to {}.
